label: rem:fivetwo-three-sevens
title: Three different sevens attach to $5_2$ — the determinant, the $\tau$-even Stokes sum, and the cyclotomic level — and none of them is the trace field
html:
Remark. Three different sevens attach to 5_2 — the determinant, the \tau-even Stokes sum, and the cyclotomic level — and none of them is the trace field

Three different sevens attach to the 5_2 knot. They arise from unrelated constructions, they live on different layers, and identifying any two of them is unsupported. The corpus has already lost a claim to exactly that error, so the distinctions are recorded explicitly here.

The three

The determinant. \det(5_2) = |\Delta_{5_2}(-1)| = 7, where \Delta_{5_2}(t) = 2t^{2} - 3t + 2 has discriminant -7 and roots (3 \pm i\sqrt{7})/4. This seven is abelian: it belongs to the Alexander polynomial and the \mathbb{Z}/7 double branched cover, and the field it generates is \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-7}), the imaginary quadratic subfield of \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_7).

The \tau-even Stokes sum. The leading Stokes constants of the two chirality blocks satisfy \mathrm{dt}^{+} + \mathrm{dt}^{-} = 4 + 3 = 7 (prop:fivetwo-dt-spectrum-split). This seven is a sum of two integers, not a field invariant, and no arithmetic meaning is attached to it; it appears in the corpus only as one of four distinct readings used to show that no single scalar reproduces the leading Stokes data.

The cyclotomic level. The level-seven ladder (prop:fivetwo-level-seven-ladder) lives in \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_7)^{+}, the totally real cubic subfield generated by w_k = 1 + 2\cos(2\pi k/7), and its seven enters through the quadratic residues \{1,2,4\} mod 7.

None of them is the trace field

The invariant trace field is the cubic of discriminant -23 (prop:fivetwo-trace-field), which is a fourth object again. Two comparisons are inviting, and both fail.

\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-7}) cannot sit inside the trace field: 2 \nmid 3, so the tower law forbids it. That is the exclusion the determinant-to-trace-field reading violates.

\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_7)^{+} has the same degree as the trace field — both are cubic — and their minimal polynomials even open the same way,

x^{3} - 2x^{2} - x + 1
\qquad\text{versus}\qquad
x^{3} - 2x^{2} + 3x - 1 .

They are nevertheless different fields, and not marginally: the first has discriminant 49, is totally real and cyclic; the second has discriminant -23, is non-Galois with Galois group S_3, and has one real place and a complex-conjugate pair. Matching degrees and matching leading coefficients are not evidence of anything.

The reusable form

Before attaching a field to a knot invariant, ask which layer the invariant belongs to. Abelian data — the determinant, the Alexander polynomial, the branched cover — carries one field. The geometric \mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{C}) representation carries another. A cyclotomic level appearing in a transported identity carries a third. They coincide for no general reason, and a shared numeral is not a shared structure.
